**The fix:** I added `Math.round()` to three price-parsing functions:
- `parseEuros()` in `src/money.js` (line 13)
- `cellCents()` in `src/money.js` (line 25) 
- `decimalCommaToCents()` in `src/locale.js` (line 18)

This ensures floating-point imprecision is rounded to the nearest cent, so prices like 39.95 are reliably converted to exactly 3995 cents.
